verdict.rationale: Zoho Books exposes an explicitly versioned REST API (root endpoint https://www.zohoapis.com/books/v3), so the versioning half of the story is documented first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or changelog commitments, which is the other half of the story. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle/sunset notice commitments, API changelog, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
